raw_comment:
I notice that the chart labels areas far from "exceptional drought" as "abnormally dry," suggesting a nationwide drought, but it avoids stating this directly, even calling a worse condition "moderate," which feels misleading.

I wonder why states like Texas and California aren’t experiencing the worst droughts despite their hot, dry climates. What’s causing this?

Most of Michigan is facing "severe" drought, though my area is only "abnormally dry." This seems to show a nationwide crisis.

Desert Warfare: Drought Hits America.
